calibration_sources: xDiT & USP Paper: A Unified Sequence Parallelism Approach for Accelerating Diffusion Models (CFG + DeepSpeed-Ulysses + Ring Attention)
TeaCache Paper (CVPR 2025/2026): Timestep Embedding Tells: It's Time to Cache for Video Diffusion Model
SageAttention-2 Paper: Efficient Attention with Smooth INT8 QK^T and FP8 PV Quantization for Video DiT

workload.cluster_node: 1 × 8×H100-80GB SXM5 Node (900 GB/s NVLink-4, $28.80/hr node cost)
workload.model_profile: 14B Video DiT (Wan2.1-14B / HunyuanVideo class, 40 layers, 40 heads × 128d)
workload.sampling_schedule: 50 Denoising Steps × CFG=2 (100 Effective Forward Passes per Video)

tiers.name: Tier 1: 朴素张量并行 TP=8 (8,000 次全序列 AllReduce 通信风暴)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Naive Tensor Parallelism TP=8 (8,000 Full-Sequence AllReduces/Video)
tiers.parallel_strategy: TP=8 (2 AllReduces/layer × 40 layers × 100 passes = 8,000 AllReduces of 75.6K tokens)
tiers.acceleration_stack: Dense BF16 FlashAttention-2 + Full 50 Steps (No Caching)
tiers.recommended_for: Never use pure LLM-style TP=8 for long-sequence DiT video generation (AllReduce volume scales with full 75,600 tokens rather than head dimension, wasting 38.5% time on collective sync).

tiers.name: Tier 2: CFG 双流并行 (CFG=2) + 纯 P2P 环状注意力 (Ring=4)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: CFG Parallelism (CFG=2) + Pure P2P Ring Attention (Ring=4)
tiers.parallel_strategy: CFG=2 (Cond/Uncond Split) × Ring=4 (P2P KV Ring Shift across 4 GPUs)
tiers.recommended_for: Cross-node slow networks or ultra-long (>512K) sequences where head count < GPU count; suboptimal inside an 8-GPU NVSwitch node due to multi-hop P2P ring scheduling bubbles.

tiers.name: Tier 3: xDiT 统一序列并行 USP (CFG=2 × 机内 NVLink Ulysses All-to-All=4)
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: xDiT Unified Sequence Parallelism USP (CFG=2 × NVLink Ulysses=4)
tiers.parallel_strategy: CFG=2 × DeepSpeed-Ulysses=4 (All-to-All Sequence-to-Head Transpose over 900 GB/s NVSwitch)
tiers.acceleration_stack: Lossless BF16 FlashAttention-3 + Full 50 Steps (100% Bitwise Lossless)
tiers.recommended_for: Lossless studio/cinema mastering workloads requiring exact BF16 50-step fidelity with 2.58x faster latency than TP=8.

tiers.name: Tier 4: USP 并行 + TeaCache 时间步残差跳步缓存 + SageAttention-2 (INT8 QK^T + FP8 PV)
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: USP + TeaCache Residual Step Caching + SageAttention-2 (INT8 QK^T + FP8 PV)
tiers.parallel_strategy: CFG=2 × Ulysses=4 (Intra-Node NVSwitch) + Async All-to-All Overlap
tiers.acceleration_stack: TeaCache (rel_l1=0.15 -> 22/50 steps computed) + SageAttention-2 (Per-Block Mean-Smoothed INT8 QK^T + FP8 PV)
tiers.recommended_for: Production interactive video generation, digital human avatars, and world-model rollout clusters demanding <7s latency and 88.4% lower unit cost.
